header.title: Visual Acuity Calculator
about.title: About This Tool
about.purpose: This calculator determines equivalent Snellen visual acuity from an object's physical size and its distance from the viewer. It also categorizes the viewing distance (Near, Intermediate, Far) and reports the expected accommodative demand.
about.visualAngleIntro: Visual Angle: Uses the exact geometric split-triangle formula to determine the subtended angle in arc-minutes:
about.equivalentAcuityIntro: Equivalent Acuity: Derives the Snellen denominator based on the standard 5 arc-minute letter:
about.accommodativeIntro: Accommodative Demand: Calculated in Diopters based on viewing distance:
about.alternateFormats: Alternate acuity (N = 20, D = Snellen denominator): MAR = D / N; LogMAR = log10(MAR); decimal = N / D; metric 6/X uses Dmetric = D × (6/20), shown as 6/round(Dmetric); M-units at the entered distance: M = distance_m × (D / N).

privacy.page.title: Privacy Policy | Visual Acuity Lab
privacy.meta.description: Visual Acuity Lab is a free, client-side calculator. We do not collect personal data or use analytics.
privacy.header.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.header.subtitle: Visual Acuity Lab (visualacuitylab.com)
privacy.section.summary.title: Summary
privacy.section.summary.body: Visual Acuity Lab is a free tool that runs entirely in your web browser. We do not operate user accounts, sell data, or use advertising or analytics trackers on this site.
privacy.section.noCollection.title: What we do not collect
privacy.section.noCollection.body: We do not ask you to sign in and we do not receive the numbers you enter into the calculator. Calculations run on your device; we have no server that stores your inputs or results.
privacy.section.local.title: Data stored on your device
privacy.section.local.body: Your browser may save a few small preferences locally (using localStorage): color theme, display language, and whether you accepted the on-site disclaimer. This information stays on your device and is not sent to us. You can clear it anytime through your browser settings.
privacy.section.hosting.title: Hosting and third parties
privacy.section.hosting.body: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages; the host may process standard web server logs (such as IP address and request time) under its own policies. We load fonts from Google Fonts when you use the site. Links such as email support or "Buy me a coffee" open external services with their own privacy practices.
privacy.section.contact.title: Contact
privacy.section.changes.title: Changes
privacy.section.changes.body: We may update this page as the tool changes. The current version is always published at this URL.
